comment: ball.c drop_ball() 899-910: a debug Valkyrie reads a wished cursed scroll of punishment, picks up the heavy iron ball, steps into a wished pit and throws the ball south: 'The ball pulls you out of the pit!' (899-901). She picks the ball up, steps into a wished web and throws it south: the ball pulls her out and the web is destroyed (902-907). She picks it up again, puts on a wished ring of fire resistance, wishes lava under herself (she sinks in, TT_LAVA) and throws the ball north: 'The ball pulls you out of the lava!' (908-910).
